title: UK Standard Visitor visa
destination_description: England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland
visa_description: Up to 6 months for tourism, visiting family or friends, business meetings or a short course.
source: GOV.UK Standard Visitor visa online application and Appendix V: Immigration Rules for Visitors

questions.prompt: What's the main reason for your visit to the UK?
Will you do paid or unpaid work for a UK company while you're there?
questions.help: Attending meetings, conferences or training counts as a visit. Doing the job itself, or being paid by a UK organisation, does not.

stop_if.message: Visitors can't work in the UK. You'll need a work visa, which Ta'asheera can't prepare yet.

questions.prompt: Will you stay in the UK for more than 6 months?

stop_if.message: A Standard Visitor visa covers stays of up to 6 months. A longer stay needs a different visa, which Ta'asheera can't prepare yet.

questions.prompt: Let's add your passport. You can upload a photo of its details page and confirm what we read, or type the details yourself.
When was your passport issued?
questions.help: It's printed on the details page, usually next to the expiry date.

rules.message: The issue date can't be in the future.

questions.prompt: Do you hold any other nationality or citizenship?
Which other country are you a citizen of?
Which city or town were you born in?
And which country is that in?
What's your relationship status?

options.label: Married or in a civil partnership

questions.prompt: What's your home address?
What phone number can UK Visas and Immigration reach you on?
questions.help: Include the country code, for example +961 71 123 456.

questions.prompt: What's your employment status?
What's your job title?
questions.help: As your employer would write it, for example Accountant or Software engineer.

questions.prompt: What's the name and address of your employer or business?
Roughly how much do you earn or receive each month after tax, and in which currency?
questions.help: For example 1,500 USD. Include a pension or allowance if you have one.

questions.prompt: When do you plan to arrive in the UK?

rules.message: Your arrival date needs to be in the future.
You can apply at most 3 months before you travel. Come back closer to the date.

questions.prompt: And when will you leave?

rules.message: You can't leave before you arrive.
A Standard Visitor visa covers stays of up to 6 months.
Your passport must be valid for your whole stay in the UK.

questions.prompt: Where will you stay in the UK? Give the name and address.
questions.help: A hotel, a rental or the person you'll stay with.

questions.prompt: Will you stay with family or friends?
Who are they, and how do you know them?
Roughly how much will the whole trip cost, and in which currency?
questions.help: Flights, accommodation and spending money together, for example 2,000 GBP.

questions.prompt: Who's paying for the trip?
Who's paying, and how are they related to you?
Have you been to the UK in the last 10 years?
Have you ever been refused a visa or entry to any country, including the UK?
questions.help: Answer honestly: UK Visas and Immigration checks, and a false answer can lead to a 10-year ban.

documents.label: Bank statements
documents.help: Your last 6 months of statements, showing you can pay for the trip without working in the UK.

documents.label: Accommodation booking
documents.help: Hotel or rental bookings for your stay.

documents.label: Invitation from your host
documents.help: A letter from the person you'll stay with: their address, immigration status in the UK and how they know you.

documents.label: Sponsor's letter and bank statements
documents.help: A signed letter saying they'll pay for your trip, with their recent bank statements.

documents.label: Letter from your employer
documents.help: Your role, salary, start date and the leave approved for the trip.

documents.label: Business registration
documents.help: Your business registration and recent tax returns or accounts.

documents.label: Proof of enrolment
documents.help: A letter from your school or university confirming you're enrolled and have permission to travel.

documents.label: Previous visas and passports
documents.help: Copies of earlier visas or passport stamps. They help show you return home after trips.

documents.label: Travel plans
documents.help: A flight reservation or itinerary. UK Visas and Immigration advise not buying tickets until you have the visa.
